download_resource_by_key: download a named PAQ resource like paq.PAQ or models.retrievers.retriever_multi_base_256 using the download function
download_single_file: download a single file from an S3 URL to a specified output directory using download_file
extract_tar_gz: extract a tar.gz archive file to its parent directory using the untar function
unpack_gzip_file: decompress a gzip file to a specified output path using the unpack function
run_download_cli: run the download CLI tool with --name to fetch a PAQ resource by key name
